optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Quality Analytics Specialist, Automotive Parts Plant

professionalSummary.text: Four-year experience as a Quality Analytics Specialist at a body components plant, responsible for analyzing inspection and scrap data, running statistical process control charts for 22 critical characteristics, preparing monthly supplier quality reports, investigating capability drops, and documenting investigation limitations and hand‑over conditions.
professionalSummary.witness: Quality analytics specialist at a body components plant for four years, analysing the plant's inspection and scrap data and running the statistical process control charts for the twenty-two critical characteristics on the two stamping lines.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared monthly supplier quality reports accepted by both customers' supplier quality engineers each month.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly supplier quality report for the plant's two customers under their supplier quality agreements, with the reports accepted by both customers' supplier quality engineers each month.

experienceHighlights.text: Investigated capability drops with line supervisors, running measurement studies with the metrology lab and securing corrective action approval from the plant quality manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Investigated capability drops with the line supervisors under the plant's investigation procedure, running the measurement studies with the metrology lab; the corrective actions were approved by the plant quality manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented investigation limitations and hand‑over conditions, filing with the plant quality manager's approval record.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation file, filed with the plant quality manager's approval record.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a work sample containing one month of control charts, a monthly supplier quality report, and an investigation file with approval record, all linked to quality system references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one month's control charts for one stamping line, one monthly supplier quality report and one investigation file with its approval record, with the quality system references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Statistical Process Control, Data Analysis, Supplier Quality Reporting, Investigation Procedures, Corrective Action Coordination, Documentation and Traceability
skills.witness: Quality analytics specialist at a body components plant for four years, analysing the plant's inspection and scrap data and running the statistical process control charts for the twenty-two critical characteristics on the two stamping lines.

evidence.text: Quality analytics specialist at a body components plant for four years, analysing the plant's inspection and scrap data and running the statistical process control charts for the twenty-two critical characteristics on the two stamping lines.
Work sample: one month's control charts for one stamping line...
Prepared the monthly supplier quality report for the plant's two customers under their supplier quality agreements, with the reports accepted by both customers' supplier quality engineers each month.
Work sample: one monthly supplier quality report...

Investigated capability drops with the line supervisors under the plant's investigation procedure, running the measurement studies with the metrology lab; the corrective actions were approved by the plant quality manager.
Provided the corrective action data to the plant quality manager for each investigation, recording in the investigation file which analyses were mine and which belonged to the supervisors.
Work sample: investigation file with approval record...
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each investigation file, filed with the plant quality manager's approval record.
Work sample: investigation file with hand-over conditions...

supportedClaims.claim: Four-year experience as a Quality Analytics Specialist at a body components plant, responsible for analyzing inspection and scrap data, running statistical process control charts for 22 critical characteristics, preparing monthly supplier quality reports, investigating capability drops, and documenting investigation limitations and hand‑over conditions.
supportedClaims.witness: Quality analytics specialist at a body components plant for four years, analysing the plant's inspection and scrap data and running the statistical process control charts for the twenty-two critical characteristics on the two stamping lines.

interviewSignalRisks.text: Interviewer's note: he has a strong accent, and some of the line supervisors may struggle to understand him on the floor; worth flagging to the manager.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify communication clarity during on‑site observation or a follow‑up interview with line supervisors.

followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Explanation of limitation assessment and hand‑over protocol.
